articles.title: 校馆弦歌丨中央民族大学图书馆：万卷藏珍 同心报国
articles.highlight: 中央民族大学图书馆的万千文献，藏着中华民族多元一体、交融共生的历史密码，实证各民族同心报国的千年脉络。
articles.summary: 这篇报道聚焦中央民族大学图书馆的馆藏文献，将其视为读懂中国的一把钥匙。文章强调这些典籍与文献记录了中华民族多元一体、交融共生的历史进程，也印证了各民族休戚与共、同心报国的千年脉络。对非技术读者而言，它提供了一个观察公共文化机构如何承载国家叙事与历史记忆的具体样本。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示在于：图书馆不只是藏书场所，馆藏文献的整理与呈现方式本身就在塑造人们对历史的共同理解；评估这类文化项目时，可重点看它是否把抽象的历史叙述落到可查证的具体文献上。
articles.sourceExcerpt: 如果说馆藏典籍是读懂中国的钥匙，那么中央民族大学图书馆的万千文献，就藏着中华民族多元一体、交融共生的历史密码，实证着各民族休戚与共、同心报国的千年脉络。

en.highlight: The vast holdings of the Central Minzu University Library preserve the historical code of the Chinese nation's unity in diversity and its millennia-long record of all ethnic groups sharing one fate.
en.summary: This report focuses on the collections of the Central Minzu University Library, presenting its documents as a key to understanding China. It stresses that these texts record the historical process of the Chinese nation's unity in diversity and mutual coexistence, and testify to a millennia-long thread of ethnic groups sharing a common fate and serving the nation together. For a non-technical reader, it offers a concrete example of how a public cultural institution carries national narrative and historical memory.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that a library is not merely a storage space: how collections are organized and presented shapes shared understanding of history, so such cultural projects should be judged by whether abstract historical narratives are grounded in verifiable documents.
en.title: Central Minzu University Library: Treasures in Ten Thousand Volumes, One Heart in Serving the Nation

articles.title: 我国科学家赴尼泊尔开展联合科考 研判喜马拉雅冰冻灾害
articles.highlight: 我国喜马拉雅“8·26”极端地质灾害应急跨境科学考察队从成都启程赴尼泊尔，开展冰冻圈与岩石圈巨灾应急联合科考。
articles.summary: 10月4日，我国喜马拉雅“8·26”极端地质灾害应急跨境科学考察队从成都启程前往尼泊尔，开展冰冻圈与岩石圈巨灾应急联合科考。本次科考由十余家高校与科研院所、50余名科研人员参加，属于针对跨境极端地质灾害的应急科研行动。它值得关注，因为这是官方渠道披露的一次跨国联合科考安排，涉及喜马拉雅地区的冰冻灾害研判。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点在于跨境应急科考的组织方式与参与规模：十余家高校和科研院所、50余名科研人员共同参与，说明此类巨灾研判依赖多机构协同而非单一团队。

en.highlight: China's Himalayan "8·26" extreme geological disaster emergency cross-border scientific expedition departed from Chengdu for Nepal to conduct joint research on cryosphere and lithosphere catastrophes.
en.summary: On October 4, China's Himalayan "8·26" extreme geological disaster emergency cross-border scientific expedition set off from Chengdu for Nepal to carry out joint emergency research on cryosphere and lithosphere catastrophes. More than 50 researchers from over ten universities and research institutes are taking part in this expedition, which is an emergency scientific response to cross-border extreme geological hazards. It is worth noting because it is an officially disclosed arrangement for a multinational joint expedition focused on assessing Himalayan ice-related disasters.
en.failureAnalysis: The key point is the organization and scale of a cross-border emergency expedition: with more than 50 researchers from over ten universities and institutes, this kind of catastrophe assessment depends on multi-institution coordination rather than a single team.

articles.title: 全球媒体聚焦 | 印度媒体：中国正在打造科技强国
articles.highlight: 印度《德干先驱报》刊文称，凭借制造能力和国家支持，中国正在打造科技强国，科技主导地位日益上升。
articles.summary: 中国新闻网国内报道显示，印度《德干先驱报》网站10月4日刊文称，中国正凭借制造能力和国家支持打造科技强国，科技主导地位日益上升。该报道同时指出，中国在科技领域的进展正受到越来越多外媒关注，因此这条消息可作为观察外部舆论视角的信号。

articles.title: Brazil goes to polls in decisive election for future of Latin America
articles.highlight: 这场高度两极分化、利害攸关的总统选举首轮投票，可能改变拉美最大国家的方向，乃至整个地区的走向。
articles.summary: 巴西选民在首轮总统选举中投票，左翼现任总统卢拉寻求第四个非连续任期，对手是极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗。弗拉维奥是特朗普的盟友，也是因政变未遂被判27年监禁的前总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗之子。这场选举被视为不仅决定巴西走向、也牵动整个拉美格局的关键节点，值得关注其对区域政治与外部关系的连锁影响。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点在于高度极化下的政权路线之争：一方是左翼现任总统寻求再任，另一方是极右翼阵营经由前总统之子延续影响力，选举结果将直接塑造巴西及拉美地区的政策方向。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro face off in battle between leftwing incumbent and far-right son of jailed ex-president Brazilians are going to the polls in the first round of a highly polarised and high-stakes presidential election that could change not only the direction of Latin America’s largest country but that of the entire region. The election on Sunday pits the leftwing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who is seeking a fourth non-consecutive term, against the far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro, an ally of Donald Trump and the son of the former president Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year sentence for attempting a coup after his failed 2022 re-election attempt.

articles.title: Would slashing migration tank the economy or reset Australia’s living standards? Canada may offer clues
articles.highlight: 加拿大年度人口增长已放缓至仅0.5%，经济正处于“调整”之中。
articles.summary: 文章讨论大幅削减净海外移民究竟会“拖垮经济”，还是带来必要的人口“重置”，以恢复澳大利亚停滞的生活水平。工党与势力上升的一国党对什么是符合国家利益的移民计划给出了截然不同的愿景。加拿大人口增速降至仅0.5%后经济正在“调整”，被视为可供澳大利亚参考的现实案例。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点是移民与经济增长、生活水平之间的关系并非单向：加拿大0.5%的人口增速及其经济“调整”提供了一个现实参照。文章呈现的是两种对立的政策主张，而非定论。

Labor and an ascendant One Nation have presented starkly different visions of what a migration program in the national interest looks like.

articles.title: C.S. Lewis on How to Structure the Days of a Creative Life and Train the Receptive Imagination
articles.highlight: 惊奇如同着魔，不是你能控制、计划或凭意志求得的东西——它降临于你，战胜你，自发而不请自来。
articles.summary: 文章借C.S.刘易斯的观点说明创意生活有两个根基：让自己规律地置身于惊奇之中，并放下自我，去接纳所遇见的东西。作者指出，惊奇无法被计划或强求，恰恰是每日作息的固定结构为这种自发时刻腾出并守住空间。它值得一读，因为它把“灵感靠运气”变成了可安排的日常习惯。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启发是：创造力并非靠等待灵感，而是先用稳定的时间安排为“惊奇”留出位置，再用接纳的心态去承接它；结构不是自由的对立面，而是自发性的前提。
articles.sourceExcerpt: There are, in my experience, two fundaments of the creative life: putting yourself regularly in the path of wonder and getting out of your own way in order to receive what you encounter there. Wonder, like enchantment, is not something you can control or plan for or will — it is something that befalls you, overcomes you, pours upon you spontaneous and unbidden. Paradoxically, what makes such spontaneity possible is structure — an organizing principle for the hours of the day that makes room, and reserves it, for these moments of magic.

zh.failureAnalysis: 关键启发是：创造力并非靠等待灵感，而是先用稳定的时间安排为“惊奇”留出位置，再用接纳的心态去承接它；结构不是自由的对立面，而是自发性的前提。

en.highlight: Wonder, like enchantment, is not something you can control or plan for or will — it is something that befalls you, overcomes you, pours upon you spontaneous and unbidden.
en.summary: Drawing on C.S. Lewis, the article argues that the creative life rests on two foundations: regularly placing yourself in the path of wonder, and getting out of your own way to receive what you encounter. Because wonder cannot be planned or willed, a fixed structure for the hours of the day is what makes room for it. It is worth reading because it turns 'inspiration depends on luck' into a habit you can arrange.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway: creativity is not about waiting for inspiration but about reserving time for wonder through a stable daily structure, then receiving it with an open mind; structure is not the opposite of freedom but its precondition.
en.title: C.S. Lewis on Structuring the Days of a Creative Life and Training the Receptive Imagination

articles.title: Journaling to remember

articles.summary: 这是一个 GitHub 上已有 4787 颗星、近期仍在活跃更新的开源项目，定位是「每个代理的模型，一个地方管理」。它把 Codex、Claude Code 这类编码代理的底层模型集中到菜单栏统一配置，让用户可以不绑定原厂模型，直接把 Codex 接到 DeepSeek、把 Claude Code 接到 Kimi。对想用低成本模型跑成熟代理工具的人来说，这类「模型与代理解耦」的中间层，正好戳中了模型锁定和切换麻烦这两个痛点。
articles.failureAnalysis: 最直接的风险是它依赖各家模型与代理工具的非官方接口，一旦上游改协议、封禁或限制第三方调用，这种中间层会最先失效。其次是需求规模：愿意在菜单栏里手动换模型的重度用户是小众人群，大厂只要在自己的代理里开放模型选择，这一层价值就被吞掉。工程上还要持续抹平不同模型在工具调用、上下文长度、提示词格式和缓存机制上的差异，维护成本高而可替代性强。商业化也更难，因为它夹在模型厂商和代理工具之间，很难向任意一端收费。
articles.highlight: 让每个代理都能自由换模型：Codex 跑在 DeepSeek 上，Claude Code 跑在 Kimi 上，全部从菜单栏一键切换。
articles.sourceExcerpt: GitHub repository with 4787 stars and recent public activity. Description: Every agent's model. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

en.highlight: Every agent's model in one place: Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, switched straight from the menu bar.
en.summary: This is an actively maintained open-source GitHub project with 4,787 stars that centralizes the models behind coding agents such as Codex and Claude Code into a single menu-bar tool. It lets users decouple an agent from its default model, for example running Codex on DeepSeek or Claude Code on Kimi. It is worth reading because it targets two real pains: model lock-in and the friction of switching providers.
en.failureAnalysis: It depends on unofficial hooks into third-party agents and model APIs, so upstream protocol changes or blocks can break it overnight. Demand is also niche: if the big labs simply expose model choice in their own agents, this middle layer loses most of its value.
en.title: yetone/magpie: Swap Any Model Into Every Coding Agent From the Menu Bar

articles.title: We're going to need default hard budget caps on pretty much everything
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: Case study
articles.summary: 文章主张按用量计费的服务和 API 应默认提供硬性预算上限，达到额度就切断并返回错误，而不是只发警告。随着编码代理和个人代理降低创建可花钱服务的门槛，失控服务可能在夜间产生高额账单，因此 AWS 和 Google Cloud 推出支出限额是值得关注的趋势。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键 takeaway 是：对可能自动调用付费资源的代理型应用，硬性预算上限应优先于事后告警。允许用户主动关闭上限，可以在保留灵活性的同时让风险责任更明确。
articles.highlight: 我认为硬性预算上限必须成为默认设置；想冒险的人可以选择关闭，但必须主动勾选。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Here's a product feature which the world is going to need a whole lot more of over the coming months and years: default hard budget caps . I'm talking about the feature of pay-by-usage services and APIs that lets you say "after $X/month, cut this thing off and return errors". These need to be hard limits.

en.highlight: I think hard budget caps need to be the default; those who want to live dangerously should be able to opt out.
en.summary: The article argues that pay-by-usage services and APIs should offer hard budget caps by default, cutting off usage and returning errors once a limit is hit rather than only sending warnings. As coding agents and personal agents make it easier to spin up money-spending services, runaway usage can generate large unexpected bills. AWS and Google Cloud introducing spend limits suggests this is becoming a trend worth watching.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that for agent-driven applications that can automatically call paid resources, hard budget caps should take priority over after-the-fact warnings. Opt-in removal of caps can preserve flexibility for those who accept the risk.
en.title: Default Hard Budget Caps Should Be the Norm
